# Web Prod Skills

> Open-source production-readiness toolkit for AI coding agents and web engineering teams building web applications.

Website: https://hari7261.github.io/web-prod-skills/
Repository: https://github.com/hari7261/web-prod-skills
License: MIT

## Contents
- Agent contract and production definition of done.
- Ten skills and ten quality/security gates.
- Engineering knowledge baselines, templates, starter eval dataset and rubric.
- GitHub Actions CI and Pages deployment workflow.

## Limitations
Some gates are static heuristics. Other gates validate reviewer-supplied evidence manifests and do not independently execute referenced tests. Read the README and gate limitations; a passing manifest is not proof of production safety.
